summary: Practise environmental audit planning, evidence testing and corrective-action tracking. Explore the five-day course and see if it fits your role.
lede: Environmental auditing helps auditors and compliance or sustainability professionals review controls, verify evidence and document findings. The course covers risk-based audit planning, evidence sampling, compliance-obligation checks and corrective-action follow-up, with practice reviewing emissions data boundaries and tracing reported indicators to source records. It connects environmental management systems and audit methods with practical tools for producing clear, traceable findings.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course suits professionals who conduct or support environmental audits, verify controls, maintain compliance evidence or report environmental performance.
prerequisites: Prior experience supporting environmental management, compliance, internal audit or sustainability reporting is recommended. You should be familiar with routine environmental records or operational controls; the course does not require programming.
